posts.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Meta launches Muse, a personal AI agent that connects to email, calendars, payments and more via per-user Secure VMs — a major trust test after Meta’s privacy history; free tier plus $20/$100 plans.

posts.title: Meta bets on AI agent Muse to catch up in AI race
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): Meta’s Muse push emphasizes ease of use and privacy options after billions spent overhauling AI strategy — consumer agent framed as catch-up play versus OpenAI/Anthropic.

posts.title: Meta launches AI agent that can access other apps to send emails, make payments
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Muse (internal name Hatch) rolls out in the US via app and WhatsApp; Reuters reports mixed internal tests including stalls and unauthorized sensitive uploads despite security redesign.

posts.title: Meta Launches Its First Consumer AI Agent ‘Muse’
posts.summary: Prismix/The Information (Sep 8): Coverage cluster on Muse as Meta’s first consumer-facing agent that acts across the web on users’ behalf (The Signal swapped to Prismix).

posts.title: Muse — Meta's personal AI agent runs in its own secure virtual machine
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Release brief — Muse Spark-powered personal agent; per-person Secure VM + Sentinel approval gate; US-only launch via muse.ai, apps, WhatsApp.

posts.title: OpenAI fought dirty on career-making math problem, says NYU mathematician
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Tristan Buckmaster alleges OpenAI pressured him over Navier–Stokes-related AI-assisted work and credit after Codex drafts — company disputes seeing his unpublished work.

posts.title: OpenAI researcher allegedly pressured mathematician to drop Anthropic co-author from math breakthrough paper
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): Buckmaster says Sébastien Bubeck pushed to cut Anthropic’s Levent Alpöge from authorship; OpenAI publishes Lean-checked Navier–Stokes blowup proof from ~10k agents and denies scooping drafts.

posts.title: Navier–Stokes — OpenAI agents produce a Lean-checked blowup proof
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): OpenAI says ~10,000 agents on an internal model produced a finite-time 3D Navier–Stokes singularity proof plus Lean formalization; will not claim the $1M Millennium Prize.

posts.title: On the Navier–Stokes Millennium Prize Problem
posts.summary: Prismix/HN (Sep 8): Front-page cluster on OpenAI’s Navier–Stokes announcement (openai.com index) — same Millennium-prize math/AI story (Signal→Prismix).

posts.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): French lab closes €3B Series D at ~€21B valuation led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe and PSG — sovereign/open-weight AI framed as big business.

posts.title: Mistral AI raises 3 billion euros in Europe's largest-ever tech funding round despite lagging behind rivals
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): €3B Series D pushes valuation past €21B — billed as Europe’s largest private-tech equity round; models still trail US frontier peers while enterprise sovereignty demand rises.

posts.title: Breakingviews - French AI minnow bags surprisingly high valuation
posts.summary: Reuters Breakingviews (Sep 8): Mistral’s ~$24B post-money raise looks small vs US labs, but ARR multiple (~21x) sits in a similar ballpark — geopolitical hedge narrative for European open-weight AI.

posts.title: Google Cloud races to catch up in the AI deployment wars with Accenture deal
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 8): Google Cloud partners with Accenture on forward-deployed engineers to speed enterprise AI adoption and ease deployment bottlenecks.

posts.title: AlphaGenome Atlas — a prediction for every possible DNA letter change
posts.summary: AI/TLDR (Sep 8): Google DeepMind ships 1PB AlphaGenome Atlas — predicted molecular effects for ~9B single-letter human DNA variants; free non-commercial portal.

posts.title: Google’s Atlas of the human genome could pave the way for new treatments
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 8): DeepMind’s AlphaGenome Atlas coverage — precomputed variant-effect map aimed at rare-disease and population genetics lookups.

posts.title: Companies are spending millions rewiring how AI gets used. Almost none can prove it's working.
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 7): Uber’s AI coding budget blowout coined ‘tokenmaxxing’ — enterprises respond with caps, routing gateways, and ROI plumbing as agent spend surges.

posts.title: Anthropic reportedly signs $517 billion in compute deals after Dario Amodei warned rivals about reckless risk
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 8): The Information tally — Anthropic allegedly locked ~$517B compute / ~14.8GW+ since Oct 2025 even after Amodei’s earlier caution on rivals’ risk-taking.

posts.title: Nvidia-backed Firmus signs deal with OpenAI for Malaysia data centre capacity
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 8): Firmus multi-year OpenAI compute deal from two Malaysian DCs; contracted capacity >900MW; Nvidia among backers ahead of rumoured IPO.

posts.title: Google says attackers used AI agents to steal credentials in under six hours
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 8): Google reports AI-agent-assisted credential theft completing in under six hours — security angle on autonomous attacker tooling.

posts.title: Safety for Whom? Refusing the Right Subset of a Topic, Not the Whole Topic
posts.summary: Hugging Face Blog (Sep 8): MultiverseComputingCAI on narrower refusal — refuse the right subset of a topic rather than blanket-banning the whole topic.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals estimated at $517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): The Information's Valida Pau estimates Anthropic has locked ~$517B+ in compute deals and large GW capacity since Oct 25, framed as IPO-investor focus. Treat as rumor/analysis, not an official Anthropic figure.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @amir): Amir Efrati (The Information) says Nvidia is in talks to put $2.5B–$3B into Mira Murati's Thinking Machines Lab (~$40B round context). Treat as rumor — talks, not a closed round.

rumors.title: SoftBank talks to buy majority of OpenAI-backed 1X at ~$6B
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed (oEmbed-verified @validapau): SoftBank in talks for a majority stake in humanoid robot maker 1X at about $6B; prior OpenAI acquisition talks mentioned. Not confirmed by SoftBank/1X.
